topPRs.title: refactor: optimize gas and modernize error handling in StandardBridge
topPRs.author: 0xkuzeydurden
topPRs.body:
### Summary
This PR modernizes the StandardBridge contract by implementing gas optimization techniques and updated Solidity error handling patterns.

### Changes
- Replaced all string-based `require` statements with gas-efficient `Custom Errors`.
- Added `unchecked` blocks for `deposits` mapping increments and decrements to save gas on arithmetic operations.
- Updated `modifier` and `internal` functions with `if-revert` patterns for better readability.
- Maintained full backwards compatibility with existing bridge infrastructure.

### Performance Impact
- Reduced gas cost for `finalizeBridgeERC20` and `_initiateBridgeERC20` calls.
- Smaller contract bytecode size due to removed revert strings.

### Target Branch
As per the contributing guidelines, I have directed this towards a feature branch to ensure proper testing for bedrock contracts.
